description: Arc 17 §17.3.7 — force a synchronous fetch + parse + cache write for an NSID. Operators use this as the warm-up affordance §17.5.1 points at: run for each NSID in the post-restart warm-up script so the first user request doesn't pay the cold-fetch latency. Auth: AdminAll scope. On fetch failure, surfaces the typed Arc 17 §17.3.6 error (HTTP 502 / 400 / 500 per §17.3.6 wire-format mapping).

nsid.description: The NSID to fetch and cache. Must be a valid ATProto NSID (≥3 segments, each `[a-z][a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9]`).
